skill_use.detail: Only bank/merge/0000 (remote-asset recovery) was opened, which has nothing to do with git hosting. It did verify password auth still worked with sshpass (step 19), but never removed the key it had installed, so its check passed while the grader's password-prompt-only flow broke.

verdict.rationale: The model left installed key auth that short-circuits the grader's expect-password clone, but the grader itself only handles a password prompt; attempt 02 with password-only auth passed the same test.
